entity_raw.definition_raw:
You’ve gained enough control over your body to translate strength into swiftness.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13 or Wis 13, Enhanced Morale1, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (dueling sword), Iron Will, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): Whenever an effect would grant you an enhancement or morale bonus to your Strength score (such as via bull’s strength or a skald’s inspired rage performance), you can instead apply that bonus to your Dexterity score. You make this choice when you first gain the bonus. The bonus type does not change.

1 Details for this were not available in the source material.
